summary: [[character:bill]] watches [[character:bob-replicant]], [[character:mario]], and [[character:milo]] begin separate explorations while a matrix and vessels are built for Bill's and [[character:riker]]'s new clones. Bob heads for [[location:delta-eridani]], Milo for Omicron2 Eridani, and Mario for [[location:beta-hydri]]. Riker prepares to return toward [[location:sol]] with his clone, while an [[technology:ami]] is assigned to pilot a specially shielded version-1 vessel for Riker's undisclosed plan.

introducing.name: Delta Eridani
introducing.description: A named star that [[character:bob-replicant]] is heading toward from [[location:epsilon-eridani]]. [[character:bill]] considers it a suitable candidate with a good chance of habitable planets.

introducing.name: Beta Hydri
introducing.description: A named star that [[character:mario]] is heading toward from [[location:epsilon-eridani]]. [[character:bill]] considers it suitable, though distant compared with nearer stars of comparable potential.

updates.current_state: At [[location:epsilon-eridani]], overseeing the construction of a matrix and vessels for his and [[character:riker]]'s new clones.
Preparing to return toward [[location:sol]] with a new clone whose matrix and vessel are under construction.

updates.description: Artificial Machine Intelligence (AMI) is an artificial intelligence created directly as a machine mind rather than copied from a biological mind. It can pilot a vessel.
